segments.name: Vegetable
segments.description: Produces and sells canned and frozen vegetable products, including the Green Giant brand, to food customers.
segments.evidence: Green Giant U.S. frozen results are reported as part of the Company's vegetable reportable segment.

segments.name: Fruit/Snack
segments.description: Produces and sells fruit and snack food products as part of the Company's food packaging business.
segments.evidence: The Company conducts its business almost entirely in food packaging with two reportable segments: Vegetable and Fruit/Snack.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Holds non-food operations including sales of cans, ends, seed and outside aircraft revenue, plus certain corporate items.
segments.evidence: The Other category consists of the Company's non-food operations including revenue derived from the sale of cans, ends, seed, outside revenue from the Company's aircraft operations, and certain corporate items.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the Company acquired the Green Giant U.S. frozen business, reported within the vegetable segment.
changes.evidence: Green Giant U.S. frozen results are reported as part of the Company's vegetable reportable segment.
